original_visible_content.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy licensed for sterile compounding prepares two products on the same morning: a sterile infusion for an outpatient, and a sterile preparation for a patient admitted as an inpatient in the same hospital under its institutional licence. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Both containers must be labelled as a sterile compounded preparation.
The outpatient container must also carry the pharmacist-contact telephone number.
The telephone must be staffed during regular hours of operation and at least 56 hours a week.
The inpatient preparation must also carry the telephone number, since the pharmacy does sterile compounding.
The pharmacist reachable on that number must have access to the patient's records.

explanation.core_reasoning: M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 21 sets two distinct duties. All drug preparations compounded by a board-licensed pharmacy must carry a label notifying users and practitioners that the drug is a sterile or non-sterile compounded preparation. Separately, pharmacies engaged in sterile or complex non-sterile compounding must provide a telephone number fostering communication between patients and a pharmacist employed by the pharmacy who has access to the patient's records, staffed during regular hours of operation every day and not less than 56 hours per week, affixed to the container alongside the compounded-preparation label. That telephone paragraph does not apply to an institutional pharmacy licensed under c. 112, s. 39I where the sterile preparation is to be administered to an inpatient within the same hospital.

choice_analysis.A: Correct: the compounded-preparation label duty reaches all such preparations.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: the outpatient container falls squarely within the telephone paragraph.
choice_analysis.C: Correct: staffed during regular hours every day and not less than 56 hours per week.
choice_analysis.D: The telephone paragraph is disapplied for an inpatient preparation within the same hospital.
choice_analysis.E: Correct: the pharmacist reached must have access to the patient's records.

related_facts: The carve-out is tied to administration within the same hospital, not merely to inpatient status
explanation.mpje_trap: One exception is written into one of the two paragraphs. Reading it as an exception to both strips the required compounded-preparation label from the inpatient container.

original_visible_content.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy licensed for sterile compounding prepares a patient-specific sterile compounded infusion for outpatient use. The ordinary prescription label is complete, but the final container does not identify the preparation as compounded and does not display the pharmacy's required pharmacist-contact telephone number. What should happen before the product leaves the pharmacy?

choices.text: Dispense it because ordinary prescription-label elements make all compounded-product labeling requirements optional.
Remove the ordinary prescription label and use only the word 'sterile' on the container.
Correct the container to identify the sterile compounded preparation and include the required pharmacist-contact information before outpatient dispensing.
Dispense it unchanged if the patient has previously received another compounded medication from the pharmacy.
Treat the missing information only as a continuing-education issue for the compounding pharmacist.

explanation.core_reasoning: The pharmacy must verify the compounded product itself, not just the prescription. Massachusetts adds a compounded-preparation designation and, for covered sterile/complex nonsterile compounding pharmacies, required pharmacist contact information for outpatient products.

choice_analysis.A: Massachusetts imposes additional compounded-preparation labeling and, for covered pharmacies, pharmacist-contact requirements.
choice_analysis.B: The additional compounded-product information supplements rather than replaces ordinary applicable labeling duties.
choice_analysis.C: The facts describe a covered outpatient sterile compounded preparation missing the additional statutory label/contact elements.
choice_analysis.D: Prior patient experience does not waive the product-specific label and communication requirements.
choice_analysis.E: The defect is on the dispensed product and communication label, not merely the pharmacist's CE record.

related_facts: Compounded-drug labeling is distinct from compounding CE.
The institutional inpatient exception does not fit an outpatient dispensing.
explanation.mpje_trap: A complete ordinary prescription label can still be incomplete for a compounded preparation.

original_visible_content.stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacist reviews outpatient labels and proposed substitutions. Assume the prescriber’s intended ingredient, strength, dosage form, and route are known. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A pharmacist distinguishes an authorized generic marketed under the brand NDA from a separate ANDA product.
A pharmacist changes an immediate-release prescription to an extended-release product with the same ingredient and strength without clarification.
A pharmacist refuses an otherwise lawful pharmacy-to-pharmacy transfer based on the patient label’s federal transfer warning.
A pharmacist gives a reconstituted medication a one-year label date without considering its shorter in-use limit.

explanation.core_reasoning: 각 선택지는 별도 기록이다. 같은 약·업무 이름보다 자격, 실제 행위, 시작점과 예외를 비교한다. Manufacturer expiry, BUD/in-use period, 일반 date ceiling 중 실제 적용되는 더 짧은 제한을 지킨다. Ingredient 뿐 아니라 strength/form/route/TE relationship 및 처방 의도를 확인한다. IR/ER 는 자동 대체가 아니다. Regulatory product relationship 을 확인한다. 같은 회사라는 이유만으로 authorized generic 을 추정하지 않는다. Label 의 다른 사람에게 약물 양도 금지와 pharmacist prescription-information transfer 는 다른 의미이다.

choice_analysis.A: 선택할 항목. Regulatory product relationship 을 확인한다. 같은 회사라는 이유만으로 authorized generic 을 추정하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: 선택하지 않을 항목. Ingredient 뿐 아니라 strength/form/route/TE relationship 및 처방 의도를 확인한다. IR/ER 는 자동 대체가 아니다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist evaluates an exact product’s therapeutic-equivalence relationship rather than relying only on the active ingredient name.
choice_analysis.C: 선택하지 않을 항목. Label 의 다른 사람에게 약물 양도 금지와 pharmacist prescription-information transfer 는 다른 의미이다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist recognizes that a required federal patient-to-patient transfer warning does not prohibit a lawful pharmacy-to-pharmacy prescription-information transfer.
choice_analysis.D: 선택하지 않을 항목. Manufacturer expiry, BUD/in-use period, 일반 date ceiling 중 실제 적용되는 더 짧은 제한을 지킨다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist applies a shorter product-specific in-use period when it is more limiting than the general label-date ceiling.

explanation.learning_boundary: 같은 모델의 9개 문항은 조건·기록 조합을 바꾸는 연습 변형이다. 독립된 9개 법규나 실제 기출로 세지 않으며, 세트에는 모델별 한 문항만 선택한다.
